scope:
Retain exact CUPTI transfer bytes and graph-node work from completed profiles.

CUDA copy bytes are transfer activity, not hardware DRAM traffic. Kernel times
may overlap; their sum is never added to API times or treated as endpoint time.
Native progress tracing inserts event fences. Those known fences are counted
separately from observed API calls; the remainder is still an intrusive result,
not an assertion of clean production synchronization behavior.

api_scope: Runtime and driver APIs can nest; their counts/times are not added together.
source_observation_scope:
Intrusive cold DF generation, whitening, SCF and complete force dataflow.

The CUDA profiler and process sampler cover fresh molecular preparation through
synchronized force completion, after library/driver initialization. There is no
priming molecular solve. Event scopes remain nested, transfer totals come from
CUPTI, and sampled memory under Nsight includes profiler overhead. These runs
are diagnostics only and never pooled with clean cold endpoint timings. The
32-GiB native observation ledger is not Python inventory admission or a whole-
process memory bound; it must return to zero after all native owners close.

observed_ledger.scope: owned CUDA buffer capacities; excludes driver/graph/pool and library-internal allocations
